query: WITH scope_tracks(track_id) AS (SELECT id FROM tracks WHERE availability IN (?, ?)) SELECT al.id FROM search_fts JOIN albums al ON al.rowid = search_fts.rowid / 4 WHERE search_fts MATCH ? AND search_fts.rowid % 4 = 2 AND al.id IN (SELECT t.album_id FROM tracks t JOIN scope_tracks st ON st.track_id = t.id) ORDER BY rank LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
